   "source": [
    "# Unemployment Analysis in India Using Python\n",
    "\n",
    "## Overview\n",
    "This project analyzes unemployment trends in India using Python-based data analysis and visualization techniques.\n",
    "\n",
    "## Objectives\n",
    "- Analyze unemployment trends\n",
    "- Study Covid-19 impact\n",
    "- Compare rural and urban unemployment\n",
    "- Identify state-wise patterns\n",
    "- Generate policy insights\n",
    "\n",
    "## Technologies Used\n",
    "- Python\n",
    "- Pandas\n",
    "- NumPy\n",
    "- Matplotlib\n",
    "- Seaborn\n",
    "\n",
    "## Key Insights\n",
    "- Covid-19 caused major unemployment spikes\n",
    "- Urban areas were more affected\n",
    "- April 2020 showed peak unemployment\n",
    "- Tripura and Haryana had high unemployment rates\n",
    "\n",
    "## Project Type\n",
    "Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)"
   ]
  },
